verdict.rationale: Chargebee's first-party RevRec docs state that it provides revenue recognition features compliant with both ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including handling of contract changes such as renewals, modifications and cancellations. The pack shows no specific deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, or how recognition is driven directly from billing data, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, explicit billing-data-to-RevRec flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Chargebee RevRec provides a comprehensive suite of revenue recognition features compliant with Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 606 and International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) 15.
RevRec is fully compliant with ASC 606 revenue recognition capabilities that cover your sales activities right from contract changes (renewal, modification, cancellation)
